scope: Resolve all 17 failures remaining from home/store performance verification without app builds or design changes

resolved_failures.fix: Editor catalog metadata uses collection.catalogTitle, matching all 133 published store titles. Original authored titles, saved album content, IDs, price keys and layer builders remain unchanged.
resolved_failures.verification: Online/offline catalog tests now run through their existing title and printable-layout assertions.

resolved_failures.issue: Recommended footer leaves All category clipped horizontally
resolved_failures.fix: StoreTopicShelf owns its horizontal controller and bounded current-category keys. One coalesced post-layout callback adjusts only the minimum horizontal distance needed to reveal the selected chip.
resolved_failures.verification: Existing footer cases assert hit testing and full chip bounds, then verify price filters. New coverage checks LTR/RTL, large text, dark mode, resize, runtime scale/direction changes, rapid selections, hidden/resumed state and disposal.

resolved_failures.issue: Search retains the parent category despite presenting all templates
resolved_failures.fix: Template search gets a route-owned feed notifier, sharing the existing local catalog, product providers and artwork caches. Parent browse filters/paging remain intact. Department is captured when opening, and duplicate queued search opens are ignored.
resolved_failures.verification: Search finds a daily design while the browse page remains in travel; four search visits retain browse item identity and selection, clear prior query, load the local catalog once and make zero full-catalog requests. Two queued button callbacks open one search route.

resolved_failures.issue: Main/store navigation assertions expect four icons
resolved_failures.fix: Tests include the existing Compass/feed icon alongside album/store/designs/profile; production destinations and stable navigation indices are unchanged.
resolved_failures.verification: All twelve size/theme/text-scale variants pass; experience navigation coverage verifies current and legacy destination values.

reviewed: Title change reads metadata only and never materializes a book document or alters an archived/saved title.
Search isolation overrides only the feed notifier. Shared catalog/product/artwork providers are inherited, and route removal disposes the child scope and existing generation-guarded interests.
The duplicate-open flag resets without setState after route completion; no recurring timer, polling or additional transport/cache layer is introduced.
Chip reveal is event driven and coalesced; ordinary pagination or scroll offset notifications do not schedule continuous geometry work.
Reveal reads current selection after layout, clamps finite offsets and updates only its own horizontal position. Fully visible chips are not recentered and hidden shelves do not move.
Key entries are pruned when category inputs change, controller ownership ends in dispose, and deferred callbacks stop when unmounted.
Existing first-entry deferral, image decode limits, worker pause/resume, cache pressure policies, pricing, ownership and favorite behaviors remain unchanged.

related_suite.initial_failure: New rapid-open test assumed a tooltip finder returned IconButton; current Flutter returns RawTooltip. Corrected the test locator to identify IconButton by its tooltip, without weakening assertions or changing production code.

limits: Code review and controlled provider/widget tests verify lifetime and request behavior; physical-device FPS, peak native memory and plugin internals were not profiled.
The shelf adds small bounded key/controller metadata; no additional image/decoded-pixel/document cache or cache-capacity increase was introduced.
